svg.aria-label: Experiment 04: payment processing is split into a first transaction, an untransacted provider call and a second transaction. A SIGKILL can land in three windows. Before the first commit it is a clean reprocess; between the two transactions the redelivery is skipped as a duplicate and the recovery sweeper re-drives the charge; after the second transaction it is a pure no-op. In all three, no booking is charged twice.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: · where a SIGKILL lands decides how the system heals

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: payment-service is the most dangerous window in the saga: its processing is deliberately split, and the provider call sits outside any transaction.

svg.text: All pods die together, so the group has no members: lag accumulates visibly while k6 keeps booking, and the recovery is a true cold rejoin plus redelivery.

svg.text: Falsifiable: a second Payment row for the same booking, a duplicate charge at the provider, a booking permanently stuck, or lag that never drains.
